properties.mineralogy: Quartz arenite with subordinate siltstone and mudstone; underlying volcanic tuffs
properties.drainage: Sloping urban drainage descending northward toward the Water of Leith basin

properties.primary_surfacing: Granite setts and dressed whinstone kerbstones with smooth bitumen carriageway infill
properties.wear_characteristics: Polished wheel-track wear on stone setts, weathered sandstone flagstone pavements, damp gutter depressions
properties.micro_grading: Northward-sloping gradient down Forres Street and Wemyss Place towards Moray Place

properties.groundcover: Enclosed private pleasure gardens with manicured perennial turf and iron-railed perimeter shrubbery

properties.primary_building_typology: Neoclassical Georgian Residential Terraced Townhouses (Moray Estate)

structures.name: Wemyss Place / Forres Street Corner Pavilions (Left Flank)
structures.roof_geometry: Pitched Scottish slate with lead hips, dormers, and ashlar chimney stacks
structures.facade_material: Craigleith polished ashlar sandstone with rusticated ground-floor and basement lightwells
structures.weathering_patina: Historical coal smoke carbon soot deposits in friezes and cornice recesses, washed cream-buff ashlar faces, cast-iron railings with oxidized black paint

structures.name: Wemyss Place Terraced Block (Right Flank)
structures.roof_geometry: Pitched Ballachulish slate with dressed stone coped skews
structures.facade_material: Fine-jointed Craigleith sandstone ashlar with classical architraves and sash-and-case fenestration
structures.weathering_patina: Deep atmospheric carbon staining along string courses, mortar repointing variations, pale mineral leaching

structures.name: Descending Moray Place Vista (Center Background)
structures.roof_geometry: Mansard and pitched slate roofs punctuated by massive multi-flue ashlar chimney stacks
structures.facade_material: Neoclassical ashlar sandstone facades with Doric/Ionic pilastered orders
structures.weathering_patina: Pronounced urban soot stratification and weathered grey-buff stone tone

period_vehicles: Parked contemporary saloon and estate cars along kerbsides
street_furniture: Traditional black cast-iron Edinburgh 'globe' street lamp columns

Dressed stone mounting blocks and cast-iron boot scrapers
pedestrian_profiles: Occasional pedestrians in urban attire walking along paved footpaths
